data.description:
Welcome to VReps Basketball - an immersive experience revolutionizing player development. Remove tedious walk-throughs from practice and allow players to take the initiative and study decision-making on their own.

Experience plays and reads from the perspective of any player on the court, or roam freely to explore the play from any angle. Interact with your plays and reads in a whole new way, and move from X’s and O’s to a 3D simulation.

Either use VReps to create custom content that reflects your basketball philosophy, or choose from our library of pre-built content. Visit https://vreps.us/player-development/ to get started.

XR Interaction Overhaul for Hand Tracking!
Fixed a bug where entering First Person sometimes would not pre-orient the user correctly

Welcome to VReps Basketball v6.0.11! This update contains:

Features:
- Lessons can be created by coaches to teach and quiz players! (On the web)
- Coaches can track their players' learning! (On the web)

Bugfixes:
- Various lessons bugfixes
- Various VR-specific bugfixes

Welcome to Virtual Playbook v5.12! Here are our latest changes:
Features: 
   - New Home Screen
   - New "On Ball" camera tracks the game ball
   - Mods to Practice Mode to ease difficulty curve
   - Pick your preferred court lines: NBA or NCAA

Bug Fixes: 
   - Frame-text and Spotlight UI de-conflicted
   - Mirrored plays will mirror court items (cones, text, etc.)
   - Quiz-questions properly de-duplicated for multi-play quizzes
   - Bugfix for close-proximity passes in practice mode
   - Bugfix for coach-led film session UI getting stuck at maximized
